apps.localizedDescription: Merchant companion for CallPages: manage your pages, read call logs and transcripts, follow the activity feed — all from your iPhone. Sign in with the same Google account as your web dashboard. Free, no ads.
apps.name: CallPages Merchant
apps.subtitle: Pages, call logs, transcripts, activity

apps.localizedDescription: Paste a Google Maps link and open the destination in your ride app — in two of them, so you can compare prices before you book. Uber, Lyft, Bolt, FreeNow, Grab, Gett and DiDi, with a primary and a second provider chosen in Settings. Free, no ads, no tracking.
apps.name: Map2Ride
apps.subtitle: Maps pin → your ride app, two providers to compare
